{"metadata":{"description":"Agent-native Grafana observability for DeepSeek Harness — dashboards, metrics, trends, alerts and multi-source investigation.","id":"gh:1336713417","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-grafana","slug":"guhanfei-ai/dsh-grafana","topics":["agent-observability","ai-agent","alerts","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","grafana","metrics","monitoring","observability"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Agent-native Grafana observability for DeepSeek Harness — dashboards, metrics, trends, alerts and mu"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"lti-source investigation."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-grafana"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin for agent-native Grafana observability — dashboards, live metrics, trends,"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" alerts and cross-source investigation, with safe, reviewable dashboard updates. It operates on Graf"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ana APIs and dashboard JSON directly; no screenshots required."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Project status: pre-1.0. The safety controls and automated tests cover the core update path, but G"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"rafana 12+ compatibility is not yet certified."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why dsh-grafana"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Fetch a dashboard by browser URL or UID, or request a compact structural summary for large dashboa"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"rds.
- Search dashboards by title and tag.
- Query the live data behind panels by pasting the dashbo"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ard or panel-view URL.
- Duplicate a dashboard into a brand-new copy and get its URL back.
- Edit pa"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"nels, queries, thresholds, variables, and layout through conversation.
- Preserve the dashboard fold"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"er automatically.
- Detect concurrent edits before writing.
- Require native DSH user approval for e"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"very write.
- Keep service-account credentials in the local DSH credential store.
- Configure severa"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"l named Grafana sources and target one per tool call."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Component | Supported baseline |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Node.js | 20.11 or newer |
| DeepSeek Harness | Default development dependency: `dsh-tools@0.2.0-r"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"c.2`; additional automated dependency checks cover `0.2.1-alpha.1`. Historical baselines: `0.1.0-rc."},{"id":"p10s3","text":"6`, `0.1.1-rc.2`, `0.1.2-rc.1`, `0.1.3-alpha.2`, `0.1.5-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.2`. Real host and browser a"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"cceptance is recorded separately in `INTEGRATION.md`. |
| Grafana | Legacy Dashboard HTTP API as doc"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"umented for Grafana 10/11 |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Grafana 12 introduced a new dashboard API. The legacy endpoints used by this plugin may remain avail"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"able, but Grafana 12+ is not part of the certified matrix yet."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Standard npm dependency resolution and DSH host preflight handle prereleases differently: the `0.2.0"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.1` host checks enable `includePrerelease`. The plugin still declares the `0."},{"id":"p12s3","text":"2.1` tuple explicitly for standard dependency resolution; this does not certify the alpha host, Desk"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"top or browser experience."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"There is no build step: the plugin is plain ESM JavaScript, so installing it is enough — nothing to "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"compile or bundle before it loads."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Install a released, immutable tag whenever possible:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Install the mutable development branch only for testing:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"For local development:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Restart the selected DSH profile after installation."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"On Windows, use an absolute `link:C:/path/to/dsh-grafana` path. The plugin itself is cross-platform."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Upgrade notes"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### 0.12.0: renamed tools and older host UI"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Two tools were renamed.** `grafana_query` is now `grafana_panel_query`, and `grafana_health` is no"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"w `grafana_status`. Parameters, outputs, timeouts, and approval behavior are unchanged."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Before | After |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `grafana_query` | `grafana_panel_query` |
| `grafana_health` | `grafana_status` |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The old names stay registered as error-only stubs: calling `grafana_query` or `grafana_health` fails"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" immediately with a message naming the new tool, so an ongoing conversation recovers in one step. Cu"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"stom prompts and saved workflows that reference the old names should still be updated, and per-agent"},{"id":"p28s4","text":" tool allowlists need the new names."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**The browser settings card requires DSH 0.1.2 or newer.** On older hosts (0.1.0–0.1.1) the card sho"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ws an explicit "host too old" notice instead of the source list — that is a version gate, not lost c"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"onfiguration. All host-side tools keep working on those hosts, and the plugin still installs on `0.1"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ost-side tools keep working on those hosts, and the plugin still installs on `0.1.0-rc.6` and newer."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### 0.17.x: settings UI and configuration migration"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Hosts exposing declaration inspection and the `settings.section` slot provide an independent **Grafa"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"na** item in the Settings left navigation, with the configuration card expanded by default. Hosts wi"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"thout that section fall back to the Grafana plugin tab or legacy embedded card; hosts without declar"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ation inspection retain the original compatibility registrations. Selection follows actual host capa"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"bilities, not version strings, and inspecting hosts register only one supported entry. Moving the en"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"try does not change configuration, source UIDs or token storage."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"**Configuration migrates automatically.** Existing named sources in the pre-upgrade `settings.yaml.i"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"mported` take priority over a legacy single-source credential; otherwise a single-source configurati"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"on is materialized as a named `default` source (same base URL, same stored token). The importer read"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"s `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml.imported`, or `~/.dsh/settings.yaml.imported` when `DSH_HOME` is unset. T"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"his maintenance cycle keeps the optional `js-yaml` dependency on v4 to preserve existing aliases and"},{"id":"p32s6","text":" `<<` merges; only the absence of that package itself enables the restricted parser for the known ba"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"sic Grafana section shape."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"File-reading, YAML-parsing or import-write failures stop migration with a redacted reason, without i"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"nferring a legacy source, changing credentials or rewriting the import file. After repairing the con"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"figuration or dependency, the maintainer can reload the plugin to retry. Migration does not overwrit"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"e a configuration saved concurrently."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Security and data boundaries"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- Tokens never enter tool arguments, model messages, logs, or Git.
- Authenticated requests reject H"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"TTP redirects to avoid forwarding credentials to another origin.
- Non-loopback plain HTTP is allowe"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"d by default (can be disabled in configuration).
- Requests have cooperative cancellation, timeouts,"},{"id":"p35s4","text":" bounded responses, and bounded dashboard input.
- Error responses expose only a bounded status/mess"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"age description.
- Grafana content is treated as untrusted data, not model instructions."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Dashboard JSON can still contain sensitive SQL, internal hostnames, links, labels, and business meta"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"data. Fetching a dashboard sends that JSON to the configured model provider as tool context. Review "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"your model provider's data policy before using this plugin with confidential dashboards."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"See SECURITY.md for vulnerability reporting and supported-version policy."}],"truncated":true}
